html: † בֵּלְטְשַׁאצַּר n.pr.m. Dn 1:7, בֵּלְטְאשַׁצַּר֑ Dn 10:1 (prob. = Bab. balâṭsu-uṣur, protect his life! COT Dn 1:7 Dl in BD Dn. p. ix; HoffmZA 1887, 56 conj. אצר בלט שׁ[ר] Balaṭ (= god Saturn?) protect the king!—Dn 4:5 conn. with Bel, but name then inexplicable), name given to Daniel by Neb.
